import json, sys, time, urllib.request, urllib.error

URL = 'https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat/stream'

def stream_chat(message):
    body = json.dumps({'message': message, 'requestId': f'qa-{int(time.time()*1000)}'}).encode('utf-8')
    req = urllib.request.Request(URL, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    t0 = time.time()
    started_at = None
    first_delta_at = None
    deltas = []
    completed_at = None
    error = None
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            ttfb = time.time() - t0
            # read SSE line by line
            for line in resp:
                line = line.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
                if not line.startswith('data:'):
                    continue
                payload = line[5:].strip()
                if payload in ('', '[DONE]'):
                    continue
                try:
                    event = json.loads(payload)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f'parse error: {e} on {payload[:80]}')
                    continue
                now = time.time()
                etype = event.get('type')
                if etype == 'response.started' and started_at is None:
                    started_at = now
                elif etype == 'response.delta':
                    if first_delta_at is None:
                        first_delta_at = now
                    deltas.append(event.get('delta', ''))
                elif etype == 'response.completed':
                    completed_at = now
                elif etype == 'response.error':
                    error = event.get('error')
                    completed_at = now
            full_text = ''.join(deltas)
            return {
                'message': message,
                'ttfb': ttfb,
                'started_ms': round((started_at - t0)*1000, 1) if started_at else None,
                'first_delta_ms': round((first_delta_at - t0)*1000, 1) if first_delta_at else None,
                'completed_ms': round((completed_at - t0)*1000, 1) if completed_at else None,
                'delta_count': len(deltas),
                'char_count': len(full_text),
                'error': error,
                'text': full_text[:500],
            }
    except Exception as e:
        return {'message': message, 'error': str(e)}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    msg = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'hello'
    result = stream_chat(msg)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
